description: Export each top-level layer or group (or the ones chosen) to its own file, named <prefix><layer name>.<ext>, by showing one at a time on a temporary copy (File > Export > Layers to Files)

blur.description: JPEG: blur before compressing, 0-2 pixels, to make the file smaller

format.description: png (PNG-24), png8, jpeg or gif. Default png

height.description: Resize the export to this height in pixels (width follows)

ids.description: Top-level layer or group ids. Default all visible ones

includeProfile.description: Embed the colour profile. Default false

trim.description: Trim each export to the layer's pixels. Default false

webSnap.description: PNG-8 and GIF: shift colours to web-safe ones within this tolerance, percent

width.description: Resize the export to this width in pixels (height follows)

name: export_layers
title: Export Layers
